Theorem
[Plane Curve Classification Theorem]

1. ch1:1.5

Suppose $\gamma ,\widetilde\gamma \colon [a,b]\to \mathbb R^2$ are smooth unit-speed curves with unit normal fields $N,\widetilde N$. They are congruent by a direction-preserving congruence if and only if \[ \kappa _N(t)=\kappa _{\widetilde N}(t)\qquad (t\in [a,b]). \]
